subject: seg23-a owns the 16.11.* genetic/metabolic leaves (primary tags); seg23-d co-tags only. Foundations: discipline tags plus the nearest leaf, as proposed
body: The count-test blocker is already fixed on shared: f35acaa (seg23-c) computes the pack totals. seg23-a: rebase and integrate your immune batch now. 16.11.01–06 count toward S23-A's coverage, and seg23-d excludes them. Every other system-16 leaf (16.01.02, 16.02.02, 16.12.01 and the rest) stays with seg23-d; seg23-a co-tags there where it fits. Foundations content is tagged by discipline (biochemistry, genetics, microbiology, pharmacology, pathology) plus the nearest leaf, as you proposed.
